stem.text: $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COCH}_2\text{CH}_3$ reacts with hydrogen cyanide to form an organic product called a cyanohydrin.

A.text: The cyanohydrin product has one chiral centre.

B.text: The cyanohydrin product is formed by electrophilic addition.

C.text: The cyanohydrin product is formed via an intermediate which contains a $\text{C–OH}$ group.

D.text: The formation of the cyanohydrin product requires the use of cyanide ions as a catalyst.
